items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: And every Christmas he sends me a card... I think you all know him... Joe Dance Boy.

ctx.x: No, most of them don't use the Chinese.
No, listen, when I got a couple Chinese, see, an old, old,

original Chinese album, he'd give it to me. And we used to go out there putting it every Sunday afternoon. I'd have a big crowd, this band that kept on playing and playing and playing, and then went out to Walsh, did it in the studio one time, played a couple of times with them. Next thing I heard they'd come up there at Five Plus Two. And every Christmas he sends me a card.
